prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='rf', seasonality_champion='FT_catboost', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: The STL decomposition reveals an upward trend in both validation folds with moderate seasonality (amplitude ~42-50). While many models achieve perfect trend correlation (1.0), FT_catboost stands out with the highest seasonal correlation (0.76), capturing the oscillating pattern better than others. DWT_catboost achieves the lowest overall RMSE (47.28) with balanced early/late performance. The high RMSE spread ratio (62.89) and seasonality variance (0.96) indicate significant model disagreement, making STL-hierarchical stacking ideal to exploit the complementary trend/seasonality strengths across models.
